MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE
  Monday, May  2023

A special meeting of the La Verne City Council was called to order by Mayor Hepburn at 4: 35 p. m.
Council Members present:  Mayor Tim Hepburn
  Mayor Pro Tem Rick Crosby
  Council Member Wendy Lau
  Council Member Steven Frank Johnson
  Council Member Meshal " Kash" Kashifalghita

Absent:  None.

Advisory personnel present:  City Manager Ken Domer
  Assistant City Manager JR Ranells
  Assistant City Attorney Scott Porter
  Finance Director Christy Lopez
  Public Works Director Meg McWade

Pledge of Allegiance led by Mayor Pro Tem Rick Crosby.

Preliminary Budget  The City Council met in a Study Session with staff on the Preliminary Budget
Presentation for Fiscal Year  for Fiscal Year 2023- 24. Members of the Finance Department presented the
2023- 24  proposed budget along with a PowerPoint presentation.

  Mayor Tim Hepburn called for public comment on this matter.

  There were two public comments. Below are only partial public comments,
  please visit the City' s YouTube channel to view the archived Council meeting.
  La Verne resident Danita Beauchamp thanked the Finance Department for the
  self-explanatory presentation of the preliminary budget and addressed
  concerns with potential projects that will be expensed through Measure LV
  funds.

  La Verne resident Rick Bowen also expressed gratitude for the clarity of the
  presentation and inquired about how the consumer price index may influence
  the price of City contracts.

  Finance Director Christy Lopez and City Manager Ken Domer responded to
  public comments explaining that the preliminary budget takes into
  consideration potential contract price increases.

  Finance Director Christy Lopez responded to the Measure LV public comment
  explaining that Measure LV ensures that General Fund dollars can be
  allocated to support City operation.

  There was one public comment. Below is only partial public comment, please
  visit the City' s YouTube channel to view the archived Council meeting.

  La Verne resident Danita Beauchamp expressed concerns with projects
  focused around Gold Line development and the population that will come
  when the station opens.

  Mayor Hepburn responded to public comment echoing concerns regarding the
  population that will come when the La Verne station opens.

  City Manager Ken Domer explained to Council that the City is requesting
  general direction to move forward with the budget. Council will meet with every
  Department Head on June 5 for a more detailed presentation on the proposed
  budget before its approval at the June 19 Council Meeting.

Council Comments  Below are only partial Council comments, please visit the City' s YouTube
  channel to view the archived Council meeting.

  Mayor Hepburn requested that Council review more details of every
  Department budget before Council provides further direction.

  Council Member Johnson proposed a motion for Council to give direction for
  City staff to move forward with the preferred budget.

  Mayor Pro Tem Rick Crosby expressed concerns with the Department' s asks
  of$ 1. 5 million in reserve funds and that the reserve fund has decreased.

  Council Member Wendy Lau thanked the Finance Department for preparing
  the presentation in a clear manner and supports Council Member Johnson' s
  motion to move forward with the preferred budget as it accounts for potential
  hidden costs.

  Council Member Meshal Kashifalghita thanked the Finance Department for
  their work and requested increased funding for Public Safety.

  Mayor Tim Hepburn also thanked the Finance Department for their work and
  that all contracts be reviewed to identify potential cost savings.

  City Council directed staff to move forward with the preferred budget which will
  be presented in further detail by each Department Heads at the June 5 special
  meeting.

Adjournment at 6: 02 p. m.

Respectfully submitted,

Andrea Blockinger
Administrative Clerk
